extracted.intended_audience: horror writers and prospective submitters/nominees (HWA members and non-members)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and FAQs for authors and publishers about eligibility, submission process, recommendations, jury handling, and nominee/winner benefits for the Bram Stoker Awards administered by the Horror Writers Association.

rubrics_metrics.name: Membership not required for consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: No! The intent of the award is to recognize the best work in the world each year, regardless of whether the author is a member of the organization or not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-members may have work considered for the award, but note that only members may recommend works and only Active members may vote. Membership affects who can recommend and vote, not basic eligibility to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only members may recommend works
rubrics_metrics.description: Only members may recommend works for the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations place works on the Recommended Reading List (members' 'top choice' reads). Being recommended by a member is not the same as becoming an official nominee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Only Active members may vote
rubrics_metrics.description: Only Active members (those who have met the criteria for professional-level writers) may vote on the awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Voting rights are limited to members with Active status; other membership categories do not have voting privileges.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member eligibility to serve on juries
rubrics_metrics.description: Members may also serve on Bram Stoker Award juries (depending on their membership level, their qualifications, and the availability of open slots on the juries).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Jury service is selective and contingent on membership level, demonstrated qualifications, and open positions — not automatic for all members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommendation is not a nomination
rubrics_metrics.description: A recommendation means only that one person has liked your work, not that it has received enough recommendations or votes to become an actual nominee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not publicize or claim 'nominee' status based solely on being recommended; nominations require sufficient recommendations/votes per the award process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work must fit an award category to be eligible
rubrics_metrics.description: If I wrote something that doesn’t fit any of your categories – can it still be eligible for a Bram Stoker Award? Sorry, no.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions must fall within one of the award's defined categories; works outside existing categories cannot be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominee/winner benefits and entitlements
rubrics_metrics.description: If I’m nominated, what do I get? ... You will receive a Nomination Certificate, hand-signed by the organization’s President and suitable for framing; you will get your own listing on this website; you may place one of our official nomination seals on your work; and you will be eligible to purchase discounted tickets to the gala awards banquet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees do not receive free StokerCon admission; benefits are limited to certificates, website listing, use of official seals, and discounted banquet tickets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission acknowledgement and communication policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Once you Submit your work to the Jury, you will receive one (1) auto-generated letter informing you that the Jury has received your work. You will not hear from the Jury again regarding your work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not contact the jury to ask whether they received your work or for their opinions. If you did not receive the single auto-generated receipt, check spam first, then contact stokerchair@horror.org.

rubrics_metrics.name: Jury selection leads to Preliminary Ballot and promotion option
rubrics_metrics.description: If your work is chosen by the Jury, it will show up on the Bram Stoker Awards Preliminary Ballot and you will be contacted for a Special iMailer to promote your work before voting begins for the Final Ballot if you wish to do so.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Being chosen by a jury triggers placement on the Preliminary Ballot and optional promotional communications; follow instructions if contacted for the Special iMailer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recommended Reading List reflects member recommendations only
rubrics_metrics.description: Works that appear on The Recommended Reading List are solely works that have been 'Recommended' by HWA members as their 'top choice' read(s) for the awards year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Recommended Reading List is distinct from jury submissions or nominations and reflects individual member recommendations rather than any formal jury or ballot status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Official nomination/winner seals availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Hurrah – I’m a nominee/winner! Where can I get the official seals to put on my nominated/winning work? Right here (see below)! Or click here to obtain a zipped file of the medallions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official seals/medallions are provided by HWA for use by nominees and winners via download; follow HWA-provided resources for correct use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trademark protection of the award name
rubrics_metrics.description: The little R in the circle means HWA has done the hard legal work of reserving trademark on the name of our awards, and our attorneys will descend upon anyone who tries to use the name for their awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Bram Stoker Awards name is trademarked; unauthorized use of the name for other awards or promotions may lead to legal action.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location of complete official rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Where can I read the complete Bram Stoker Awards rules? Please click here to access the PDF of the complete rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For definitive eligibility criteria, procedures, category definitions, and other formal standards, consult the complete rules PDF linked by HWA.
